_comment: === BrightSign NPU Anomaly Detection - Unified Configuration ===
_comment_modes: Three detection modes: 1) Basic (reference.enabled=false), 2) Auto (reference.mode='auto'), 3) File-based (reference.mode='file')

device._comment: USB camera settings - auto-detected by extension, can override with registry/env

reference._comment_enabled: true = reference-based detection (auto or file), false = basic peer-to-peer comparison only
reference._comment_mode: Options: 'auto' (online reference building), 'file' (load pre-recorded reference), 'record' (record reference only)
reference._comment_ref_fps: Reference timeline frame rate - should match anomaly.sample_fps
reference._comment_search: Matcher searches ±4s around predicted position for timeline resync
reference._comment_auto_source: 'tv_id' = use specific monitor as reference (best for demos), 'consensus' = medoid selection across all monitors
reference._comment_ref_tv_id: Which monitor provides reference timeline when auto_source='tv_id' (e.g., 'tv1' = left monitor)
reference._comment_warmup: Warmup period before enabling FREEZE/LAG/MISMATCH detection (BLACK detection works immediately)
reference._comment_max: Max reference history in memory (ring buffer) - 600s = 10 minutes
reference._comment_persist: Save generated reference to file for debugging/replay
reference._comment_embeddings: Path to pre-recorded reference embeddings file
reference._comment_index: Optional: FAISS index for faster search (not implemented yet)

roi._comment_mode: Rectangular ROI extraction - define multiple monitors below
roi._comment_important: ⚠️ ADJUST COORDINATES TO MATCH YOUR CAMERA FRAMING! ⚠️
roi._comment_howto: Use frame capture or image stream to find correct x,y,w,h values for each monitor

tvs._comment: Left monitor - REFERENCE SOURCE (clean video) - provides timeline for auto mode
Right monitor - TEST MONITOR (video with anomalies) - compared against reference

roi._comment_single_roi: For basic mode (reference.enabled=false), use single ROI covering entire frame:

anomaly._comment_enabled: Master switch for all anomaly detection
anomaly._comment_sample: Analysis frame rate - MUST match reference.ref_fps for proper timeline sync
anomaly._comment_black_desc: Luma-based detection with hysteresis (different enter/exit thresholds to reduce flapping)
anomaly._comment_black_mean: Adjusted for camera auto-exposure: pure black (25.0) vs camera-captured black (110.0)
anomaly._comment_black_var: Higher variance threshold for real-world camera conditions
anomaly._comment_black_note: Works immediately, no warmup required. Active in ALL modes.
anomaly._comment_tuning: Based on logs: black segments show luma ~96-108. Threshold at 110 with variance < 5000.
anomaly._comment_freeze_desc: Detects when monitor timeline stops advancing while reference continues
anomaly._comment_freeze_sim: High similarity between consecutive frames indicates freeze (basic mode)
anomaly._comment_freeze_note: In auto mode: armed after warmup. In file mode: always active. In basic mode: uses frame-to-frame similarity.
anomaly._comment_mismatch_desc: Detects when content significantly differs from reference
anomaly._comment_similarity: If similarity < 0.75, content is considered mismatched
anomaly._comment_mismatch_note: In auto mode: armed after warmup. In file mode: always active.
anomaly._comment_lag_desc: Detects when monitor is behind reference timeline
anomaly._comment_lag_detail: Trigger if monitor is >1.5 seconds behind reference
anomaly._comment_lag_note: In auto mode: armed after warmup. In file mode: always active.
anomaly._comment_stutter_note: In auto mode: armed after warmup. In file mode: always active.
anomaly._comment_peer_desc: When reference.enabled=false, monitors are compared against each other
anomaly._comment_timeout: Trigger CAMERA_OFFLINE if no frames received for 5 seconds

mqtt._comment: MQTT events tagged with tv_id (tv1, tv2, camera, etc.) to identify source

logging._comment: Logs are also visible in system journal: journalctl -f -u bsext-anomaly
